corrections.why: The May 23, 2022 visit report describes the tower as standing, though damaged. The Forest Fire Lookout Association index still marks it gone. No later report was found, so the current status needs a check before any change.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register lists lookouts that were standing when registered, and the 2022 visit confirms this tower stood then. The index's gone status is undated.

notes_for_editor: Status conflict: the NHLR visit report (May 2022) shows the tower standing and damaged; the Forest Fire Lookout Association index marks it Gone. Current status is unknown; a human should check before changing the record. No access level set: the report shows a barbed-wire fence and no signs, but no source says whether the public may visit. The story gives no climbing advice. The register's location line names the Virginia Department of Forestry; it is not confirmed as administrator. The register credits a May 2022 photo to Rocco Germani; no image URL was captured. The Forest Lookouts Deerhead Mountain page (easternuslookouts.weebly.com/deerhead-mountain.html) adds only the county and was not cited.
